parsed.reason: Description A says daily grouping splits one day into multiple totals when timestamps have mixed UTC offsets (non-adjacent same-day events, and no UTC conversion). Description B says quantity is never reset after yielding a day, so totals become running sums across days. The code shows quantity += event.quantity with no reset on group change, which is the defect B describes; A's mixed-offset scenario is a different failure at the same lines.
